stories.title: Two Sudbury officers charged with obstruction after man’s carbon monoxide death
stories.summary: Two Sudbury police officers have been charged with obstructing justice in connection to a 19-year-old man’s carbon monoxide death last year.

stories.title: Winning Mississauga Lotto 6/49 Gold Ball ticket worth $38M: OLG
stories.summary: A winning Lotto 6/49 Gold Ball ticket sold in Mississauga is worth $38 million, the Ontario Lottery and Gaming Corporation (OLG) says.

stories.title: Stellantis sale of plant to Roshel only a ‘partial solution,’ Carney says
stories.summary: At the heart of the issue is whether Stellantis is obligated to hold up its end of a funding agreement that saw millions in taxpayer dollars being given to the company.

stories.title: Raptors live and die by the three-pointer
stories.summary: It was all going so well for the Toronto Raptors in the first quarter of their key divisional matchup against the Boston Celtics.

stories.title: Tatum helps Celtics rally past Raptors 98-93
stories.summary: Jayson Tatum scored 24 points as the Boston Celtics rallied to a 98-93 win over the Toronto Raptors on Wednesday.

stories.title: Toronto man admitted killing roommate but says he doesn’t want NCR finding
stories.summary: Ahmed Al Farkh has spent the last five years at Waypoint Centre for Mental Health Care awaiting trial after being charged with murdering his roommate Nathaniel Brettell.

stories.title: Two Mississauga men charged after $86K in coffee machines stolen
stories.summary: In July, police said officers responded to a call for a break-and-enter at Mississauga building. Investigators found that nine-high commercial coffee machines had been stolen.

stories.title: Mistakes continuing to cost slumping Maple Leafs
stories.summary: The Maple Leafs had worked hard to get back on level terms.

stories.title: Landeskog, Avs hand Leafs fourth straight loss
stories.summary: Gabriel Landeskog scored his second goal of the game in the third period as the Colorado Avalanche topped Toronto 6-3 to hand the Maple Leafs their fourth straight regulation loss Tuesday.
